title: Private, Quiet Cottage Guesthouse
description:
Close enough to everything but also far enough away to provide a restful retreat. 3 room cottage has a private bedroom as well as a full size sleeper sofa in the living room. Neighborhood is close to airport but only 7 miles from downtown.

The space
We are in a safe, quiet neighborhood but still close enough to everything wonderful Nashville has to offer. 

Amenities include:
Free, Off Street Parking
Free Wifi
Microwave
Mini Fridge

Pets considered with a $50 per pet fee.

You will be provided with one roll of toilet paper. Additional roles are the responsibility of the guest.

Guest access
You have access to the entire private cottage.

The cottage is completely detached from the house.

Other things to note
If you want to try some of Nashville's best country cooking, Monell's at the Manor is right around the corner. 

Downtown is 10-15 minutes away depending on the traffic. 

Very close to the airport but also easy access to interstates to get wherever you want to be quickly.
